correctness.rationale: The standard exact graph-Hom face poset on the specified 11-vertex, 20-edge target is fully enumerated, not sampled: every multi-homomorphism contains a singleton and is reachable by admissible single-coordinate additions. Independent adjacency fifth-trace confirms 310 singleton maps. An embedded complete list of 150 free edge/square pairs is checked in order against the entire remaining two-cell incidence; the resulting graph has 310 vertices and 350 edges and BFS confirms connectivity. Its spanning tree has 309 edges, giving a wedge of 41 circles by integral graph topology. The replayed standalone program and actual certificate are embedded. Risk: exact computer-assisted finite certificate, not independently audited.

value.rationale: The canonical five-cycle is an odd-cycle graph-Hom homotopy-test source; the Grötzsch target is the smallest four-chromatic triangle-free graph, created by Mycielski from the same five-cycle and containing an essential four-cycle obstruction to square-free target theory. Determining its entire connected graph-Hom homotopy type and the explicit 2-cell collapses is a motivated boundary case, not an arbitrary numerical slice or Euler-characteristic-only exercise, and supplies a precise reproducible benchmark for non-square-free Hom topology. No general family theorem is claimed.
